column1: # The store's foundations (docs/AGENT_ASSET_STORE.md §4): a few standard props per archetype that
# transform into the rest. Start from one of these, place a variant, or fork it. transforms are
# examples, space-separated, each one tested to build (crates/pav_tools/tests/foundations.rs):
# for the asset's $roles), `seed=N` (a seeded variant). why: the technique it shows, at most 40
# tokens. `assets shelf=prop` lists them first with their knobs; STORE.tsv marks them.

column4: why
Legs, aprons and stretchers by from/to: one length knob moves 8 fields. :wide merges Kenney's low wide table.
A lathe pedestal on radial feet; the height knob reaches into the lathe's profile points.
Extruded A-frame trestles; the runner shows by a chance knob and takes the $accent role colour.
Tapered legs under an apron: height scales every vertical field, width only x; a choices knob hides the drawer.
One choices knob rewrites 8 fields: the back goes (a stool) or rises (high back); the sit socket stays.
Extruded trestle legs under a plank seat; the length knob keeps them under the seat ends.
Fork of Quaternius bench_1: slats rebuilt as arrayed rounded boxes so one knob sets their length.
An extruded D-profile log with a sawn face; the length knob carries ends and chocks; seeds add branch stubs.
A stave lathe in four iron hoops; a choices knob swaps the hoops' material, the seed shows a bung or not.
Fork of Kenney's 115 cm barrel: an 8-sided lathe and bands; height and girth reach into profile points.
Reuses LIB/core/barrel by ref, rolled onto notched cradles; the size knob scales the ref and moves the rest.
An open lathe turning down inside its rim; diameter reaches profile radii, hoops and lugs; fill drains it.
Coals, flames and light all use $light, so a roles palette recolours the fire; seeds jitter the flames.
A radial ring of candles whose count is a knob, round a tall candle whose height is another.
Back on the wall at z 0 (wall_mount); a choices knob drops the flame with its light, reach sets the arm.
Fork of Quaternius bonfire_lit: radial stones and leaning logs, coals glowing in $light, flames by choice.
Grouped crates with seeded jitter; a choices knob sets the top crate's chance: by seed, never or always.
Fork of Kenney's chest: the lid is a group pivoting at its hinge, so a choices knob swings it open.
Arrayed slats round a produce grid; one choices knob swaps the produce's material and size, or empties it.
An open wicker lathe under a half-torus handle (arc, axis z); gridded apples on a heap show or empty by choice.
Fork of Kenney's sword: blade extrude points and guard width are knobs; grip socket, +y toward the tip.
Fork of Kenney's spear: a from/to shaft whose length knob carries collar and head; grip on the shaft.
An extruded bearded head on a from/to haft; the haft knob moves head, eye and poll together.
A from/to shaft whose length knob carries collar and crystal; a choices knob recolours the crystal or drops it.
Arrays with material cycles; choices knobs replace the cycle lists (goods, awning) or empty the crates.
Fork of Quaternius marketstand_1: a striped wedge roof whose peak knob turns gable into shed.
Thin poles under a low wedge canopy in $accent; the width knob spreads poles, table, bolts and valance.
Radial posts and valance under a cone roof in $accent; one diameter knob spreads roof, posts, counter and goods.
A style choice swaps material, radii and whole pos vectors: a stone lantern or a bracket arm.
One body group: a choices knob hangs it from its ring; a style choice makes a brass mine lamp.
A tapered stave lathe; height scales profile, hoops and bail; style swaps to a tin pail.
One style choice switches whole groups on and off and lifts the bedding onto each deck.
Choices swap the infill (bars) and the frame (lintel, torii in $accent, field posts).
Size scales bale and mirrored twine bands; form shows a round roll or a second bale on top.
An arc tube hull rolls on its keel; one choice swaps canoe radii, one poses the oars.
Mirrored half-triangle extrudes; size carries body, fly, poles and door; shape makes a bell tent.
One extrude head whose points a choices knob swaps: pick, broom, spade, sledge, rake.
A concave U extrude with end caps; fill picks water or hay; material swaps the planks base.
One choices knob turns groups on and off and moves a shared fire: fireplace, oven or forge.
Groups cannot scale, so size scales the belly and wall radii; a hang choice puts the bail on the origin.
